title: A2 Core checkpoint
subtitle: Read a short Gospel or epistle paragraph with a defensible method.
overview: You are ready to move beyond isolated sentences when you can map a short paragraph, name its grammatical relationships, and translate without pretending uncertainty has vanished.
This checkpoint measures reading habits: structural observation, careful lexical choice, discourse awareness, and restraint in interpretation.

sections.title: A2 Core outcomes
rows: track narrative verbs, speech, and participles
choose a sense from phrase and context
show how clauses advance the author’s thought

items.grc: ταῦτα γέγραπται ἵνα πιστεύσητε ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: These things have been written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God.

items.grc: καὶ ἵνα πιστεύοντες ζωὴν ἔχητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.
items.en: And so that, believing, you may have life in his name.
